The gaps

Why people look for an alternative

Interview Coder is a popular, broad interview-prep copilot — but a few gaps send users looking elsewhere.

Limited Behavioral Support

Interview Coder (Cluely) is built primarily for coding challenges. Behavioral, situational, and HR interview questions receive generic, minimal support — leaving candidates unprepared for the rounds that often decide the final offer.

Visible in System Monitors

Interview Coder / Cluely is not hidden in Task Manager (Windows) or Activity Monitor (macOS). This system-level visibility creates unnecessary detection risk with technically sophisticated interviewers.

Higher Price

Interview Coder / Cluely's subscription model costs significantly more than Amigo's pay-as-you-go credits. You pay a fixed monthly fee regardless of how many interviews you actually have.

The edge

How Amigo pulls ahead

6 places Amigo outperforms Interview Coder.

Full Behavioral Support

Every Round, Not Just Coding

Amigo supports behavioral, HR, situational, and system design interviews with natural STAR-format answers — tailored to your resume and the specific role. Interview Coder / Cluely focuses almost entirely on coding rounds.

Deeper Stealth Mode

Hidden Even in Task Manager

Amigo is invisible on screen share and also in Task Manager (Windows) and Activity Monitor (macOS). Interview Coder / Cluely is visible in system process monitors — Amigo isn't.

Coding Interview Copilot

HackerRank, LeetCode, CoderPad

Amigo's screen-reading coding copilot matches or exceeds Interview Coder / Cluely — with step-by-step hints, pseudocode, time complexity analysis, and working solutions in real time.

Buddy Feature

Live Human + AI Support

Invite a trusted friend or mentor via a shareable link. They send real-time AI-assisted tips through your Amigo overlay during the interview. Interview Coder / Cluely offers no equivalent.

Natural STAR Answers

Resume-Personalized

Amigo generates answers based on your uploaded resume and the job description. Responses are in STAR format, adjusted to your preferred length, and sound like you — not generic text.

30% Lower Price

Pay-As-You-Go, No Subscription

Amigo's credits start at $15 for 2 hours — roughly 30% cheaper than Interview Coder / Cluely's subscription plans. Free credits on sign-up, no lock-in.
